Hymn 289: Holy Temples on Mount Zion
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major
Composer: Alexander Schreiner
Lyricist/Text Author: Archibald F. Bennett
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 289 titled "Holy Temples on Mount Zion" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Alexander Schreiner and the lyrics were written by Archibald F. Bennett.
